articles.title: Disney D23 Takeaway: With ‘X-Men’, ‘Tangled’, ‘Incredibles 3’ & More, Movie Studio Poised To Slay In 2028
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Anthony D'Alessandro Anthony D'Alessandro Editorial Director/Box Office Editor @AwardsTony More Stories By Anthony Disney D23 Takeaway: With ‘X-Men’, ‘Tangled’, ‘Incredibles 3’ & More, Movie Studio Poised To Slay In 2028 Lucasfilm Co-Boss Dave Filoni On ‘Hunt For Ben Solo’ Pic Future: “The Force Is Not With Us…” – D23 ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Super $67M Third Weekend; ‘Odyssey’ Sailing Past Half Billion, Dinos Fight For Third – Box Office Update View All August 15, 2026 6:18pm Disney teases upcoming slate at 2026 D23. Disney/Pixar/Marvel Studios The morning after an intoxicating D23 Friday night, which included a dancing spirit squad, Adam Driver and Inde Navarrette X-Men surprises, Josh Gad crooning, Ryan Gosling, Anne Hathaway and confetti raining, it became really clear — Disney is going to have a killer 2028 at the box office. And they haven’t even filled out the entire year’s slate yet. With the 2026 domestic box office racking toward an estimated $10 billion stateside, will people still be going to the cinemas two years from now? Hell yes, if Disney has anything to do with it. Related Stories Books All Things Spidey At D23: Tom Holland, Anniversary Comic Book, 'Friendly Neighborhood' Sneak-Peak, 'Amazing Friends' Renewal & Upcoming Special 'Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!' News Lucasfilm Co-Boss Dave Filoni On 'Hunt For Ben Solo' Pic Future: "The Force Is Not With Us..." - D23 Disney has 14 dates currently in the Rentrak system for 2028 — and that’s not counting 20th Century Studios or Searchlight theatrical releases. Again, dates can always shed, but with the few tentpole dates that were announced last night at D23’s The Ultimate Disney Fan Event at the Anaheim Honda Center, coupled with what we already know, it would not be shocking if 2028 has a shot at rivaling Disney’s record global year at the B.O., which was 2019 with $13.15B (that’s when they were fully merged with 20th Century Fox). Watch on Deadline Right now for 2028, if the studio can keep these productions on track, Disney has dated: Pixar original Ghost Market – March 10 Currently, no other wide release is dated against it. Live-action Tangled – March 31 Amazon MGM Studios has a Chosen movie already on the schedule which is counter-programming to this highly anticipated feature adaptation of the 2010 animated pic. Tangled arrives in theaters a week ahead of Sony’s The Beatles – Four Films The Beginning on April 7, 2028. Marvel’s untiled X-Men – May 5 The MCU returns to its formerly prized summer launchpad, three years after 2025’s Thunderbolts* . Who dare date against this revival? In the hands of Feige, it’s not like Bryan Singer’s old stuff. From the looks of last night, per Hugh Jackman’s beam-in, he ain’t coming back as Wolverine. Live-action Lilo & Stitch 2 – Memorial Day weekend, May 28 Currently, Lionsgate has Resurrection of the Christ: Part Two on this date. Again, counter-programming skewing to an older adult religious demo. The two can co-exist, but depending on how successful Part One is (May 6, 2027), it would’t be shocking if Lionsgate changes their mind in the face of a five-quad sequel to a billion-dollar movie. Pixar’s Incredibles 3 – June 16 Before D23, Disney already announced the Fathers Day weekend date for the threequel to one of the highest grossing animated movies of all-time ( Incredibles 2 at $1.2B). The kids—Violet, Dash and Jack Jack—are the same height, but grown up in their superhero abilities as the conceit here is that they sneak out of the house more. No other major studio pics are versing Incredibles 3 yet. Marvel’s Ghost Rider – announced for 2028 without a specific date on the Gosling starring, Shawn Levy directed feature, but a good guess is that it’s going to July 28 that year as Disney has that weekend on hold in Rentrak. If it is July 28, well, that’s the penultimate end of summer date where Deadpool & Wolverine , Brand New Day and Fantastic Four: First Steps have soared. You’d be crazy to date against this movie. Marvel’s Black Panther 3 – Dec. 15, 2028 Clearly, the Christmas event movie of the year. Universal has an untitled tentpole dated five days later on Dec. 20. That’s quite a killer lineup on paper alone, and more powerful from what’s already on deck in 2027 for Disney, which we’ll sift through below. Here’s some takeaways from last night’s fireworks: (L-R) Maya Boyd, Inde Navarrette, Samara Weaving, Christopher Abbott, Kit Connor, Jake Schreier, and Sadie Sink speak onstage at the Disney Entertainment Showcase at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event on August 14, 2026 in Anaheim, California. (Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Disney) Marvel Cinematic Universe Movies Are No Longer in Superhero Fatigue With three MCU titles dated for 2028, that’s absolutely clear, and with MCU Boss Kevin Feige involved in the success of Sony’s highest grossing movie of all-time, the Marvel Studios co-production Spider-Man: Brand New Day at $1.8B+, “It’s not about IP,” says one Disney executive talking about the success of that rival film. “It’s about making great movies. Spider-Man: Brand New Day isn’t successful because it’s a Spider-Man movie, it’s successful because it’s an excellent, fun movie.” That’s the plan for MCU going forward: Reliable and fun-filled filmmakers and talent like Ryan Gosling and Shawn Levy involved in Ghost Rider , and a murderers’ row of thespians in X-Men such as Driver, Obsession breakout Navarrette, Christopher Abbott and Samara Weaving, to name a few. There was some cynicism from fans over the Avengers: Doomsday trailer that was released around San Diego Comic-Con, which is to be expected. You can’t spoil everything in a trailer for a highly anticipated sequel. Also, who isn’t going to watch this upside-down universe MCU movie where Iron Man ‘s Robert Downey Jr. is Victor Werner von Doom? The clip released last night shows this is a more complex, sinister strategist than Josh Brolin’s crash-bang-boom baddie Thanos from the previous Avengers pics. Screams Pedro Pascal’s Reed Richards, “Answer me, Victor! Why did you do this?” Masses will want to know well into early 2027 in what’s an optimistic start to Disney’s 2027 box office year. Joker: Folie a Deux , this is not. And after the better-than-Barbenheimer success of The Odyssey and Brand New Day in the marketplace, it’s clear we won’t have a problem of two male fandom-charged properties like Doomsday and Dune: Part 3 getting in each other’s way. Both battalion boats will rise at the B.O. Kathryn Hahn and Mother Gothel from ‘Tangled’ Kathryn Wirsing/Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures Live Action Takes Of Disney Classics Aren’t Going Away While Honda Center denizens last night could only get excited by less than a minute’s tease of Tangled , which showed Rapunzel’s long blonde hair and Kathryn Hahn briefly as notorious Mother Gothel, Disney isn’t bailing on bringing legacy animated classics into the flesh with even Moana recently falling off her surfboard with less than $300M at the global box office. Disney’s plan per sources going forward remains, of course, spacing out animated sequels from their live-action counterparts, as well as finding a unique way into beloved vault titles (i.e. a Bridesmaids -like spinoff of Cinderella from Akiva Schaefer with Stepsisters , not shown yesterday), the still-in-development punk rock Cruella 2 from Craig Gillespie starring Emma Stone, and the upcoming Beauty and the Beast -verse title, Gaston . Maleficent years ago was a great success for the studio. If that Sleeping Beauty spinoff taught Disney anything, it’s to approach live-action adaptations of the classics from the side in an edgy way rather than a full-on adaptation (i.e. Dumbo , Pinocchio , Snow White ) with great filmmakers and sublime stars. Quite often, the old pics are dated in their morals and arrive with inherent themes which are more baggage than their worth for the studio when trying to pull in a pluralistic audience. Another lesson from Moana : Don’t make a carbon copy of the original animated pic. Better to vary it up with different musical numbers and deeper plots for fun’s sake. Also when it comes to non-Disney IP movies, the current motion picture administration is on the hunt for the next YA hit, which can easily fit into the Magic Kingdom’s sensibilities both spiritually and merchandising wise, read winning a big auction for Katherine Rundell’s Impossible Creatures , a publishing phenomenon on the order of Harry Potter , The Hunger Games and Twilight Saga (no updates yesterday). Animation Is Intact With Frozen 3 , a November 2029 date for Coco 2 and Incredibles 3, clearly Disney knows when it comes to making $1 billion hits, it never fails to make a sequel to a landmark hit. And ya gotta space ’em out. Frozen 3 arrives eight years after its previous chapter, Incredibles 3 is ten years later than its predecessor while Coco 2 will hit theaters 12 years after Coco . Disney kept their powder dry on what to expect on Coco 2 and Incredibles 3 , showing very little footage. Essentially what we learned were plot reveals. Original Walt Disney Animation title, Hexed , due out at Thanksgiving, about a young woman coming into her bewitching powers while facing off against a coven, looks like it can work, elevating the leading independent female sensibility that the studio’s princess toons are known for, while also being the flip side of a Disney princess. Walton Goggins as a wisenheimer three-eyed Southern cat, Beef Roger Crummchuk, to Hailee Steinfeld’s protag, Billie Doe, is very funny and very Goggins. Disney vet Jodie Foster in her first Disney animation voiceover role as the villain, Queen Celeste, is intriguing. Well played, casting. Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel Jesse Grant/Getty Images But get ready for Frozen 3 . At the last D23 two years, they merely teased concept art, but this year, Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel (Anna and Elsa) rocked a new song, “Frozen Heart” while Josh Gad brought down the house with a new 1970s love song-sounding ditty about Olaf’s new g.f., “Samantha”. Add in a new black icy witch villain with powers that could topple Elsa and more about the ice sister’s past, and we got a great Star Wars -like film on our hands. The Jennifer Lee-directed threequel hits theaters on Nov. 24, 2027. If you want to build franchises, you have to make originals, and as we know in the current post-Covid space, sometimes that means opening at a significantly lower gross and playing out. Pixar has always won in the original space when they do their own twist on a genre (i.e. space with Wall-E , French movies with Ratatouille ) and anchor it on an emotionally affecting lead character. Not an easy needle to thread ( Elio ), but it appears they have something as they venture into horror with Ghost Market about a fast talking kid who has a supernatural interaction at a lunch shop hidden away in a remote location on Oʻahu’s North Shore that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. Mum’s the word on Avatar There was no mention of the future of the Na’vi last night. Two movies remain on the release calendar, Avatar 4 for Dec. 21, 2029 and Avatar 5 for Dec. 19, 2031. As far as the fate of those pics, all we know is what franchise director James Cameron has said following the threequel’s $1.48 billion (the lowest in the franchise, but, hello, still an excellent gross for any movie). They’re “still floating out there.” A New Hope for Star Wars ? Nothing new was announced, and this is the one label which requires the most resuscitation after Mandalorian and Grogu died this summer with $345M WW. Rather than getting lost in their heads on what to do with the Skywalkers or legacy characters after failing to take fans into hyperspace with 2018’s Solo: A Star Wars Story , Lucasfilm opted to go anew with elements that create alchemy, read the comedic and story awe of director Levy, scribe Jonathan Tropper and the cool and hysterically funny Gosling in Star Wars: Starfighter . It looks amazing, like Gosling’s Driver from Drive in space amid some new cool sea-filled planets. There’s an older mentor-to-kid story, and a nod to the drag race aura that George Lucas wove from his teen days into American Graffiti and Star Wars: Phantom Menace . For any die-hard Star Wars fans, there’s a lot of call-back in the imagery, but the question is whether they’ll buy into something completely fresh. The box office comp here isn’t Levy’s Deadpool & Wolverine ($211.4M domestic opening) which was working off a successful superhero comedy property, it’s more the spinoff of bigger IP, think 2016’s Fantastic Beasts coming off of Harry Potter ($74.4M domestic debut). There’s a lot of pressure on Levy and Gosling to truly take us to another galaxy far, far away next Memorial Day weekend. Meanwhile, per newly appointed co-president, Dave Filoni, when it comes to an Adam Driver starring The Hunt for Ben Solo movies; fans, it’s not the movie you’re looking for, to quote Obi-wan Kenobi. Filoni told Deadline that when it comes to the next movie after Rise of Skywalker, “The force is not with us in that regard.” This was the second time in the Disney fan confab’s history that they’ve wowed their future film and TV lineup at the Honda Centre (called D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event), taking what was once a filled theater-like presentation at the Anaheim Convention Center to what’s now an Ariana Grande-like concert spectacle with floating balloons, Broadway numbers and the entire arena doing “the wave” before the start of the show. articles.title: ‘Outlander’s Caitríona Balfe Joins Live-Action ‘Tangled’ As Queen Arianna
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Glenn Garner Glenn Garner Associate Editor @xoxo_glenn More Stories By Glenn ‘Outlander’s Caitríona Balfe Joins Live-Action ‘Tangled’ As Queen Arianna Mason Thames Reveals He & McKenna Grace Filmed ‘Nimrods’ Before ‘Regretting You’, Talks Possibility Of Doing “Another Job Together” All Things Spidey At D23: Tom Holland, Anniversary Comic Book, ‘Friendly Neighborhood’ Sneak-Peak, ‘Amazing Friends’ Renewal & Upcoming Special ‘Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!’ View All August 15, 2026 8:39pm Caitríona Balfe has been cast as Queen Arianna in Disney's live-action 'Tangled'. Getty/Disney From 18th century Scotland to the fictional Kingdom of Corona, Disney ‘s live-action Tangled has found its Queen Arianna. While Outlander star Caitríona Balfe was not featured in the footage teased Friday at D23 , Disney has announced the 5x Golden Globe nominee will play Rapunzel’s long-lost mother in the adaptation of the 2010 animated fantasy musical. Also unveiled in conjunction with D23 were the castings of Elliot Cowan ( The Crown ) as King Frederic, and Patrick and Hugo McPherson ( Pear ) as the Stabbington twins. The join the previously announced Teagan Croft as Rapunzel, Milo Manheim as Flynn Rider, Kathryn Hahn as Mother Gothel and Diego Luna (Andor) as a new character, Hawthorne, in the Michael Gracey-helmed movie, from a script by Jennifer Kaytin Robinson and Michael Montemayor. Related Stories News ‘Tangled’ Live-Action Pic From Disney Sets 2028 Theatrical Release – D23 News Kathryn Hahn Confirms Role Of Mother Gothel In Disney’s Live-Action ‘Tangled’ Movie Announcing a March 31, 2028 release date during Friday’s D23 panel, Disney also teased a first look at footage of Croft and Hahn in the film. Watch on Deadline In the original Tangled , magical long-haired Rapunzel (Mandy Moore) spent her entire life in a tower until runaway thief Flynn Ryder (Zachari Levi) stumbles upon her, after which she sets out to discover the world for the first time, and who she really is. The cast also included Donna Murphy, Ron Perlman, Brad Garrett and Jeffrey Tambor. articles.title: Disney Unveils Avengers Infinity Defense Lead By Ms. Marvel, Return Of Avengers Cast, Harrison Ford Models New Indiana Jones Attraction, Villains Land & More At D23
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Destiny Jackson Destiny Jackson Crafts Editor, Awards @DestinyDreadful More Stories By Destiny Disney Unveils Avengers Infinity Defense Lead By Ms. Marvel, Return Of Avengers Cast, Harrison Ford Models New Indiana Jones Attraction, Villains Land & More At D23 All Things Spidey At D23: Tom Holland, Anniversary Comic Book, ‘Friendly Neighborhood’ Sneak-Peak, ‘Amazing Friends’ Renewal & Upcoming Special ‘Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!’ Lucasfilm Co-Boss Dave Filoni On ‘Hunt For Ben Solo’ Pic Future: “The Force Is Not With Us…” – D23 View All August 15, 2026 10:21pm Disney California Adventure Park Avengers Campus Disney/Marvel The happiest place on earth just got more global. At the D23 ’s Saturday Parks Panel, host Neil Patrick Harris gave way to several Walt Disney Imagineers who shared the next steps in the mouse house’s billion-dollar expansion . ​ In the U.S., executives and creative designers showed off a sneak peek of upcoming West Coast attractions at Disney California Adventure. Coming to Avengers Campus to join the likes of Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: Breakout! and Web Slingers: A Spider-Man Adventure are two new attractions. The first is a flight-spinning ride called Stark Flight Lab, which will see guests take on training trips from returning Avengers cast members Robert Downey Jr., Anthony Mackie and Brie Larson. The second big-ticket attraction will be Avengers Infinity Defense, a ride that puts the fight against Thanos in the hands of park visitors. As they enter, riders will receive special mission orders from Ms. Marvel (featuring a role reprisal from Iman Vellani) and team up with Avengers and their returning actors, Hawkeye (Jeremy Renner), Captain America (Mackie), Thor (Chris Hemsworth) and Iron Man (Downey Jr.). Both attractions will open in 2028. Related Stories News 'Outlander's Caitríona Balfe Joins Live-Action 'Tangled' As Queen Arianna News Disney D23 Takeaway: With 'X-Men', 'Tangled', 'Incredibles 3' & More, Movie Studio Poised To Slay In 2028 A few familiar faces are joining in on the action 💪 @RobertDowneyJr , Anthony Mackie and @ChrisHemsworth will be featured in Avengers Infinity Defense opening at Disney California Adventure in 2028 ⭐ #D23 #Disneyland pic.twitter.com/bPJaXJYmhl — Disney Parks (@DisneyParks) August 16, 2026 Meanwhile, near DCA’s Paradise Pier, a Coco boat ride will usher guests through the world of Miguel via a museum-like flowing river that will highlight Mexican and Día de Muertos culture and showcase artifacts of and music by Miguel’s great-great-grandfather Hector. Joining ranks with Walt Disney World, DCA will also become home to the Na’vi via an Avatar Destination to be announced at a later date. Watch on Deadline ¡Mira! A new look at the Coco-themed attraction coming to Disney California Adventure 🎶✨ #D23 #Disneyland pic.twitter.com/y3qTEjVlKi — Disney Parks (@DisneyParks) August 16, 2026 Over on the East Coast, the Walt Disney World resort is breaking ground on its latest attraction, Indiana Jones and the Myth of the Jade Serpent, which becomes the first park to involve titular star Harrison Ford as an animatronic model. Ford, who could not attend in person, sent a video explaining his excitement at being involved in the ride mechanics for the first time. While Tokyo Disney, Disneyland Paris and Disneyland have established Indiana Jones attractions, this will be Walt Disney World’s first. We have unearthed Indiana Jones news 🤠 For the first time ever, Harrison Ford is the actual model of the Indiana Jones Audio-Animatronics figure, fear of snakes included 🌳 #D23 #AnimalKingdom #WaltDisneyWorld pic.twitter.com/NULBc78sUe — Disney Parks (@DisneyParks) August 16, 2026 Director and head of Walt Disney Animation Jared Bush came out to talk about an Encanto ride called Antonio’s Fiesta de Encanto; all of the cast from the film will be reprising their roles. Housed in the film’s iconic Casita, guests are invited to Antonio’s Gifts Day, where he receives the power to communicate with animals. Riders will travel through the Madrigal family’s home on pieces of elaborate, colorful furniture, viewing the story of the house while interacting with more than 50 animals throughout the attraction. Attractions for Encanto – coming to Animal Kingdom – and Villains – coming to Magic Kingdom | #D23 pic.twitter.com/Vdf8RfsoKW — Deadline (@DEADLINE) August 14, 2026 ​ And finally, though Disney remains the number one home for “happily ever afters,” Imagineering has been brewing up a wicked side. Villains Land, which is exactly what it sounds like, is the destination for fans of all baddies. Executives teased that the Walt Disney World attraction will contain a high-thriller roller coaster experience on Maleficent’s thorny briar mountain top featuring “elements never attempted before on a Disney theme park attraction,” and another flume ride will feature the Evil Queen’s Magic Mirror, who might get to tell his side of the Snow White story. What do we have here 🖤Welcome to Villains Land at Magic Kingdom 🏰 pic.twitter.com/xeRaP9xRDa — Disney Parks (@DisneyParks) August 16, 2026 With ‘X-Men’, ‘Tangled’, ‘Incredibles 3’ & More, Disney Poised To Slay In 2028: Analysis Marvel Pic Casts Abbott, Driver, Navarette & Boyd; Release Date Set ‘Spider-Man’ $65M No. 1; Dino Movies Fight For $20M 3rd Place ‘Traitors’, ‘Top Chef’ ‘Summer House’, ‘Survivor’ & More On Day 1 Read More About: Comments

articles.title: ‘Tangled’ Live-Action Movie Unveils First-Look, March 2028 Release Date
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Kirsten Chuba Plus Icon Kirsten Chuba Events Editor kirstenchuba Follow Sign Up View All August 14, 2026 8:51pm 'Tangled' Courtesy of Everett Collection At its D23 fan event on Friday, Disney offered up a first look at its upcoming live-action adaptation of Tangled . The clip began with a shot of Teagan Croft, who is playing Rapunzel, from behind, with her long blonde hair cascading over cobblestone streets. The footage then cut to Kathryn Hahn as the duplicitous Mother Gothel, before Hahn took the stage to thank fans for manifesting her casting. The star joked her character “may be a little overprotective, but that’s because she cares so much” and added, she’s “the best kind of villain, the kind who thinks she’s actually a hero.” Croft and co-star Milo Manheim also sent a virtual message, appearing in costume as they said hi to fans from their set in Spain. The studio also announced a release date of March 31, 2028. Related Stories Movies Lisa Kudrow and Mira Sorvino Bring 'Romy and Michele 2' to D23: "We're Officially Disney Princesses" Movies Disney Reveals 'Lilo & Stitch 2' Will Feature Stitch's Pink Counterpart Angel TANGLED live-action movie gets a release date (and a first teasing look that had fans cheering) … March 31, 2028. pic.twitter.com/LeKk0WzJhg — Borys Kit (@Borys_Kit) August 15, 2026 At the beginning of the year, the studio cast rising Australian actress Croft as Rapunzel, the curious and plucky would-be princess with magical hair, and Zombies star Manheim as Flynn Rider, the cocky outlaw thief who helps her escape her tower prison. In the 2010 animated version — now regarded as a modern classic and part of Disney Animation’s second renaissance — those roles were voiced by Mandy Moore and Zachary Levi. Rounding out the live-action cast, Diego Luna has also joined the film in a new role. Michael Gracey, who counts the musical biopics Better Man and The Greatest Showman among his credits , is directing the feature, which, like the original, will have big musical elements. Kristin Burr, who has long-standing ties to the studio and was a producer on Freakier Friday as well as 2021’s live-action Cruella , is producing. Jennifer Kaytin Robinson ( I Know What You Did Last Summer , Thor: Love and Thunder ) and Michael Montemayor ( Everyone I Know is Dead ) wrote the script. The original animated film grossed over $591 million and spawned a popular Disney Channel series. Filming for the new adaptation began earlier this summer in Spain. THR

articles.title: Marvel Unveils Trippy First ‘VisionQuest’ Trailer
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Kirsten Chuba , Aaron Couch August 14, 2026 9:05pm Paul Bettany Marvel Studios/ Disney+ It’s the beginning of the end for the WandaVision trilogy, as Marvel unveiled a first-look trailer for VisionQuest and set an Oct. 14 premiere date. Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige brought out stars Paul Bettany, who stars as the synthetic member of the Avengers, as well as James Spader, who returns as Ultron, the villain from 2015’s Avengers: Age of Ultron. “It’s been an enormous joy playing Vision as he’s evolved through the years, helped turned the tide in some enormous battles… rather inconveniently died a number of times … Although I’m told in the Marvel universe no one is really dead, unless Kevin says they are,” Bettany said, before unveiling a trippy first trailer. Picard showrunner Terry Matalas is behind VisionQuest . The series follows the 2021 serise WandaVision , which dealt with Wanda Maximoff’s (Elizabeth Olsen) grief after the death of Vision in Avengers: Infinity War . The story continued with Agatha All Along (2024), centered on WandaVision antagonist Agatha (Kathryn Hahn). Bettany has been with the Marvel Cinematic Universe since it’s dawn, when he voiced TonyS tark’s AI assistant Jarvis in 2008’s Iron Man . He first played Vision in Age of Ultron , and in addition to the live-action movies and TV shows, has voiced the character in the aniamted series What If…? THR

articles.title: ‘X-Men’ Finally Unveils Its Cast, Including Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Christopher Abbott

After years of speculation, and a furious few months of screen tests and dealmaking, Marvel unveiled its X-Men cast at D23 on Friday night. articles.title: Ryan Gosling Shows Off First Footage From ‘Star Wars: Starfighter,’ About “A Guy From the Wrong Side of the Galaxy”
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Kirsten Chuba Plus Icon Kirsten Chuba Events Editor kirstenchuba Follow Sign Up View All August 14, 2026 9:32pm Ryan Gosling (left) and Shawn Levy at the Star Wars Celebration in Tokyo, Japan. Tomohiro Ohsumi/Getty Images for Disney Logo text Star Wars : Starfighter touched down at D23 on Friday night, as Disney showed off first footage from the film during its Entertainment Showcase. Ryan Gosling and newcomer Flynn Gray lead the latest Star Wars entry, a stand-alone movie that is set after the events of 2019’s Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker . Director Shawn Levy appeared at the event, telling the room of fans that the project “embodies themes of hope and family and adventure” that the Star Wars franchise is known for, but “in a timeline never explored.” He then trolled Gosling with a clip from The Mickey Mouse Club (where Gosling got his start), before bringing out his star, declaring it was the most pivotal role of his career. Related Stories Movies 'X-Men' Finally Unveils Its Cast, Including Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Christopher Abbott TV Marvel Unveils Trippy First 'VisionQuest' Trailer Gosling then appeared in a Mickey jacket, declaring, “I owe a lot to Disney… and I’m now here 30 years later and I’m back and it’s changing my life again.” He then switched jackets to feature one with the logo of his character Kade, who he described as “a guy from the wrong side of the galaxy whose fate is intertwined with the fastest starfighter ever built.” Then he teased to the audience, “Can we show you something?” and cut to a glimpse of the movie. STAR WARS at D23: Director Shawn Levy presents Ryan Gosling with a special STARFIGHTER jacket “with the symbol of your character, Kade Auberon.” Gosling describes him as “a guy from the wrong side of the galaxy whose fate is intertwined with the fastest starfighter ever built.” pic.twitter.com/uDSEHLoWJk — Borys Kit (@Borys_Kit) August 15, 2026 In the clip, Gray is shown uncovering a ship as Gosling stumbles him, saying, “Didn’t I tell you not to touch anything?” He says the ship is the fastest starfighter ever built and when Gray’s character says he’s never heard of it, Gosling says “There’s a reason for that.” The interaction was followed by some action-packed scenes of ships sailing across the sea and classic Star Wars moments in space. Levy directed the project , which features a star-studded supporting cast of Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, Simon Bird, Jamael Westman, Daniel Ings and Amy Adams. Starfighter is set to hit theaters on May 28, 2027, after it wrapped filming at the end of 2025. “The reality is that this script is just so good. It has such a great story with great and original characters,” Gosling told the audience when the film was first announced at Star Wars Celebration in Tokyo . “It’s filled with so much heart and adventure, and there just really is not a more perfect filmmaker for this particular story than Shawn.” Starfighter is also the first of two high-profile collaborations coming from Gosling and Levy, as Marvel revealed during its Comic-Con presentation last month that the Barbie star would play supernatural horror hero Ghost Rider , in a new big-screen incarnation of the character. Levy will also direct the Ghost Rider film, which is currently set for a 2028 release. THR

articles.title: ‘Zootopia 3’ In the Works at Disney
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Kirsten Chuba Plus Icon Kirsten Chuba Events Editor kirstenchuba Follow Sign Up View All August 14, 2026 9:34pm Zootopia 2 Courtesy of Disney Last year, Zootopia 2 became the biggest Hollywood animated film of all time, landing $1.87 billion at the worldwide box office; now, a third movie is on the way. The announcement was made during Disney ‘s D23 fan event on Friday by Disney Animation head Jared Bush, with Ginnifer Goodwin and Ke Huy Quan also on hand. “The bunny and the snake will be back!” Goodwin declared, as Bush confirmed this iteration will see the return of its fan-favorite characters and feature the introduction of a bird-centered storyline. The hit franchise follows optimistic young rabbit Judy Hopps (Goodwin) and sly red fox Nick Wilde (Jason Bateman) as they partner together as rookie cops, solving crimes in the animal metropolis of Zootopia. The original 2016 film grossed over $1 billion worldwide, and nine years later, the sequel proved to be an even bigger smash. Related Stories Movies Ryan Gosling Shows Off First Footage From 'Star Wars: Starfighter,' About "A Guy From the Wrong Side of the Galaxy" Movies 'X-Men' Finally Unveils Its Cast, Including Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Christopher Abbott Even before Zootopia 2 went on to break records, the team was already looking ahead, with Goodwin telling The Hollywood Reporter at the November 2025 premiere, “I’m putting everything out there trying to manifest a number three, after a much shorter break. All we’ve got to do is get everyone in the world to go see the movie, it’s not a lot to ask.” Directors Jared Bush (who serves as chief creative officer of Walt Disney Animation) and Byron Howard also had their eyes on doing more with the franchise. Bush said at the time, “If it goes well, we would spend the rest of our careers in the world of Zootopia . It’s the most fun place in the world and there’s so much left to explore. We’ve actually only seen one city on one continent on one planet. There’s quite a lot more stories to tell.” THR

articles.title: Kieran Culkin to Star in Animated Movie ‘Clay’ for Disney
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Aaron Couch , Kirsten Chuba August 14, 2026 9:41pm Kieran Culkin Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images Kieran Culkin is moulding his career to include a new animated movie from Disney. He will voice star in Clay , which is centered on a man chosen to be a mentor — but his mentee is a moldable ball of clay, who he must keep alive on a journey through a fantastical forrest. Disney Animation’s Jared Bush made the announcement at Disney’s D23 fan event on Friday to reveal the news, and announced a release date of November 2028. Culkin won a best supporting actor Oscar as well as a Golden Globe in 2025 for A Real Pain , and won an Emmy and a Globe for his breakout work as Roman Roy in HBO’s Succession . Coming up, he has The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, in which he plays Caesar Flickerman, the character played by Stanley Tucci in the original features. He also has a role in Nancy Meyer’s upcoming movie for Warner Bros., which is expected for 2027. Also as part of the D23 presentation, Disney Animation announced an upcoming Zootopia 3 and new additions to its project Hexed , with Jodie Foster and Walton Goggins joining lead Hailee Steinfeld in the voice cast. Sister division Pixar also showed off what it had in the works, including Incredibles 3 and Coco 2 . THR

articles.title: ‘Ahsoka’ Season 2 Brings the Force — and More Anakin Skywalker — with First Trailer
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Aaron Couch Plus Icon Aaron Couch Film Editor View All August 14, 2026 9:44pm Rosario Dawson in 'Ahsoka.' Courtesy of Lucasfilm/Disney+ Logo text Ahsoka is heading back to the small screen, with the first look at season two of the Star Wars series arriving during D23 Friday. In the footage, Ashsoka trains with a force ghost of Anakin Skywalker as she embarks on new challenges, declaring, “We’re in more danger than I thought.” She’s seen in climates all around the galaxy, navigating with support from her wide-ranging group of space friends and being pushed to her limit. Anakin pushes her at one moment, “Are you a Jedi or not?” The season will bow in early 2027 on Disney+. Related Stories Movies Kieran Culkin to Star in Animated Movie 'Clay' for Disney Movies 'Zootopia 3' In the Works at Disney Per the logline, “As Ahsoka and her Jedi apprentice Sabine Wren travel across a mysterious and perilous world to find their way home, their friends Hera, Ezra, Zeb, and Chopper, must face the powerful Grand Admiral Thrawn and his sinister allies, who seek to plunge the New Republic into war.” Rosario Dawson returns to lead the series as the title Jedi hero. Hayden Christensen will return as Anakin, while the role of Baylan Skoll will be played by Game of Thrones alum Rory McCann, who steps in for the late Ray Stevenson. Season one of the show also starred Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Natasha Liu Bordizzo, Ivanna Sakhno, Diana Lee Inosanto, Eman Esfandi, Evan Whitten, Genevieve O’Reilly and Lars Mikkelsen Ahsoka bowed three years ago in August 2023 and was a solid ratings performer for the streamer. It hit Nielsen’s top 10 original streaming series charts every week that it premiered new episodes. Lucasfilm co-chief Dave Filoni is behind the project after co-creating the character for the animated Star Wars: The Clone Wars nearly 20 years ago. THR

articles.title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Footage Shows Off a “Broken” Doctor Doom
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Aaron Couch Plus Icon Aaron Couch Film Editor View All August 14, 2026 9:48pm Doctor Doom in 'Avengers: Doomsday' Marvel Logo text Doctor Doom finally gets his closeup in the latest Avengers: Doomsday trailer. Robert Downey Jr.’s villain is front and center in the new look of the film, which returns the actor to the Marvel Cinematic Universe for the first time since Avengers: Endgame . It’s the same look that was shown at San Diego Comic-Con last month, but is now available to the public as of Friday night, where it also screened at D23. As part of the presentation, Hugh Jackman sent in a clip of himself on camera, with Deadpool whispering to him off screen. “Just wanted to check in, just wondering if you might need some help rounding out the cast?” Deadpool coaches him what to say and they bicker. “I’d love to join and I might be able to convince Ryan to appear in Avengers: Doomsday .” Related Stories Movies 'Avengers: Doomsday' Tickets Put On Sale For All Theaters Nationwide Movies Chris Evans Teases "Brutal" 'Avengers: Doomsday' Storyline for Captain America (Ryan Reynolds appeared at Comic-Con in character as Deadpool, where he crashed the Doomsday panel to suggest he wanted in on the movie. The Russo Bros. direct the film, which has a sprawling cast, ranging from stars of the original 2000s X-Men movies such as Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen, to original Avengers cast such as Chris Evans and Chris Hemsworth, to Black Panther ‘s Letitia Wright and Winston Duke to more recent MCU additions, such as Shang-Chi ‘s Simu Liu and Fantastic Four: First Steps ‘ Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, and Joseph Quinn. There’s also Captain America actor Anthony Mackie and Ant-Man s star Paul Rudd, in addition to Thunderbolts players Sebastian Stan, Florence Pugh, Wyatt Russell and David Harbour. Marvel has unveiled a few looks at the movie publicly so far. There were a series of character-based teasers released in late 2025 and early 2026, as well as a trailer unveiled in July . The feature has a release date of Dec. 18. THR

articles.title: ‘Frozen 3’ “Royal Wedding” Between Anna and Kristoff Is Crashed by New Villain in First-Look
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Kirsten Chuba Plus Icon Kirsten Chuba Events Editor kirstenchuba Follow Sign Up View All August 14, 2026 9:58pm Frozen II Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures / Courtesy Everett Collection Bundle up! Frozen 3 is coming. At its D23 fan event on Friday, Disney offered up a first-look at the third entry in its hit franchise, which is set to glide into theaters on Nov. 24, 2027. In celebration, Idina Menzel and Kristen Bell walked hand-in-hand onto the D23 stage before launching into a (slightly tech issued) rendition of song “Frozen Heart,” as Bell teased “Anna and Elsa are going on their biggest journey yet.” The stars confirmed that Anna and Kristoff will be getting married in the story and “this royal wedding has been a long time coming.” They added that love is in the air for everyone — even Olaf. Related Stories TV 'Ahsoka' Season 2 Brings the Force -- and More Anakin Skywalker -- with First Trailer Movies Kieran Culkin to Star in Animated Movie 'Clay' for Disney Josh Gad then arrived to sing a love song to Samantha, in reference to a joke from the second film. Menzel declared, “We will find ourselves far from Arendelle in wild and dangerous land” and cut to the footage, which showed Anna and Kristoff’s wedding seemingly being crashed by a new villain. As they trudge through an icy forrest, the villain comes down from a snowy peak and says “The sisters of Arrendale, we finally meet.” Frozen ‘s past two iterations have been a smash at the box office, with the 2013 original earning $1.28 billion and 2019’s Frozen II bringing in $1.45 billion. Menzel and Bell lead the franchise as royal sisters Elsa and Anna. Following the death of their parents, Elsa, voiced by Menzel, is to become queen but must navigate her dangerous icy powers along the way. Gad, as beloved snowman Olaf, and Groff, as Anna’s fiancé Kristoff, round out the main voice cast. Frozen 3 was originally dated for 2026 but was pushed back, with Gad explaining in 2025 , “There’s a reason the movie is coming out in 2027 and that is because no one wants to rush this. Everyone wants this to not just be a sequel or a money grab. They want this to be absolutely worthy of the story we set out to make in 2013.” He continued, “We want to give audiences something that is worth the years of waiting and years of anticipation. I know that they are actively working on that and I know that they have a story that they are very, very, very excited about.” Former Disney CEO Bob Iger previously announced that a Frozen 4 was also in development, though that film has not yet been dated. articles.title: ‘I Live in V.I.,’ a Social Class Satire From Nigeria, Will Dive Into Urban Alienation and Gentrification
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Georg Szalai Plus Icon Georg Szalai Global Business Editor View All August 15, 2026 12:20am 'I Live in V.I.' Courtesy of Locarno Open Doors Are you ready for I Live in V.I. , a social class satire from Nigeria? The project from director Ugochukwu Azuya was among the works-in-progress showcased at the 2026 edition of Open Doors , the Locarno Film Festival ‘s co-production platform and talent development program for filmmakers from equity-seeking communities and regions where artistic expression is at risk. Azuya, whose short film Swimming in Sea of Trauma was released in 2023, is working on the movie with producer Olubunmi Ogunsola of Nigeria’s Ensemble. Related Stories Movies Christine Vachon Jokes She Likes Pedro Pascal Better Than Joaquin Phoenix in Todd Haynes' 'De Noche' Movies 'Sentimental Value' Screenwriter Gets Backing For Next Directorial Feature The team behind the project, presented during the second edition of Open Doors with a focus on films from Africa, won the Tabakalera-San Sebastian Film Festival Residency Award. THR has compiled highlights about the movie and insight from Azuya about the project and the themes it explores. Synopsis Florence (23) leaves her small town in Akwa Ibom for the big city of Lagos to start a new job in the hospitality industry, after the sudden loss of her father. However, Lagos is not what it promised to be. From the poor living conditions of her apartment, the strenuous commute to Victoria Island (V.I.), insomnia and unprocessed grief, Florence begins to unravel. To cope with the demands of her job, she decides to squat in an abandoned construction site of a government building project from the 80s, much closer to her workplace. Her sudden punctuality puzzles her co-workers. Florence comes up with a lie, one where she lives in V.I, a neigborhood strictly for the wealthy, with her once-famous now forgotten aunt. All this to sustain the illusion of ‘living the good life’ in Lagos. With its möbius-strip-esque structure, this surreal social class satire about grief, urban alienation and gentrification in the city of Lagos explores the lost hope of the Nigerian dream. Director’s note “We are all just a city.” Florence is a surrogate for myself and countless young people trying to make the most of their situations while dealing with survival in Lagos, Africa’s most populous city. Just like us, she can be evasive about the emotions that make her vulnerable, constrained under capitalism. Like Florence, many leave their home states for Lagos in search of opportunity. Lagos is a city of fantasies where exorbitant displays of wealth exist alongside failing infrastructure and displaced people. With an ensemble of characters and dramatic situations that are colored with different aspects of the Nigerian collective psyche – our eccentricities, our bravado, the spirit of adapting to the most dire of situations with sheer ingenuity – the Nigerian sense of humor with its gleefully sardonic texture is what shapes this story. I want to showcase the poetry of the city: brutal, magical, chaotic. From Yaba to Oshodi, Elegushi to Obalende, Ojo to Gbagada, we all form a constellation. What was the inspiration for you to want to make this film? My inspiration comes from my personal experiences as a young person. As someone who has lived in Lagos and experienced the mechanisms of life in this materialistically driven, very classist society. The story was also borne of my experience of other people I have crossed paths with, young people, mostly women who mirror the working-class background of the film’s protagonist, Florence. I’ve always been interested in the ways in which society is constructed and how this forms our psyche both as individuals and also as a collective, especially living under capitalism as we are. I Live in V.I explores how this manifests through various social strata, i.e class, gender, social background. How universal are the themes of the film, and why should people outside Nigeria see it? I think anyone living anywhere in the world can understand what it is to leave their hometown for the promise of an urban cosmopolitan city in order to assert their identity and their hopes of changing their material conditions, whether the city is Lagos, Tokyo, São Paulo or New York City. Cities are unique milieus where millions live together at a peculiar rhythm which is intrinsic to the psyche of the city dweller. To an outsider who isn’t used to this tempo, city life can feel overwhelming and a lack of human connection can lead to loneliness against this massive concrete backdrop. What is the next step for you and your collaborators after Open Doors? Our focus as a film team at our production company Ensemble is to give the film the adequate development cycle it needs. The Tabakalera-San Sebastian Residency award, which we won at this year’s edition of Open Doors, represents the direction we want to take development in, and we are honored to have been awarded such an opportunity. THR

articles.full_text: Aug 14, 2026 9:40pm PT Disney’s ‘Hexed’ Adds Walton Goggins and Jodie Foster to Cast By Jennifer Maas , Matt Minton Jodie Foster and Walton Goggins are joining the cast of Disney’s next animated movie, “ Hexed .” The casting news was announced during the Disney Entertainment Showcase presentation at Disney’s D23 fan event in Anaheim, California on Friday. Oscar-winner Foster will play a devious witch queen, while Goggins will play a three-eyed cat named Beef Roger Crummchuk. “It is so much fun to return to Disney because that’s where my career began,” Foster said, referring to her run of ’70s films including “Napoleon and Samantha” and “Freaky Friday.” Related Stories 'Incredibles 3' Drops First Look Concept Art Ahead of Summer 2028 Release Date Starring Hailee Steinfeld and Rashida Jones, “Hexed” follows a teenage oddball and her Type A mom, who discovers her weirdness is actually hidden magic, transporting them to a world where magic can run free. Popular on Variety Josie Trinidad, the head of story on “Ralph Breaks the Internet” and “Zootopia,” is making her film directorial debut with “Hexed” alongside Jason Hand, the “Moana 2” co-director and head of story on “Encanto.” Roy Conli and Juan Pablo Reyes Lancaster-Jones will serve as producers. “Hexed” is set to release in theaters this fall on Nov. 25. Disney’s recent history with original animation like “Hexed” has been spotty. This spring’s “Hoppers” was a hit, but other films that weren’t sequels such as “Elio” and “Luca” have struggled to draw crowds. Meanwhile, established franchises remain core to Disney’s box-office strategy: Last month, “Toy Story 5” crossed the $1 billion worldwide mark since its June 19 release and stands as one of the highest-grossing films of 2026. That follows major success for 2025’s “Zootopia 2,” which beat out “Inside Out 2” to became the highest-grossing animated film of all time with $1.7 billion at the global box office. “Zootopia 2” also surpassed “Frozen 2” as Disney’s biggest animated film ever and was 2025’s highest-grossing movie. Experience Star Wars: Starfighter, starring Ryan Gosling, only in theaters May 28, 2027. pic.twitter.com/hoFlXv8nLL — Star Wars (@starwars) August 15, 2026 Disney and Lucasfilm have kept plot details about “Starfighter” locked up tight, but it’ll be the first follow-up to 2019’s “Episode 9: The Rise of Skywalker” and a fully standalone story. articles.full_text: Aug 14, 2026 9:50pm PT Marvel’s ‘X-Men’ Reboot Sets May 2028 Release Date By Jordan Moreau Plus Icon Jordan Moreau Latest Marvel’s ‘X-Men’ Reboot Sets May 2028 Release Date 5 hours ago ‘Star Wars: Starfighter’ Footage: Ryan Gosling Races Through the Galaxy With Young Sidekick 5 hours ago ‘Zootopia 3’ in the Works at Disney 5 hours ago See All Getty Images for Disney The long-awaited X-Men movie is finally coming to the MCU. Marvel Studios exec Kevin Feige made the official announcement that the X-Men movie will release on May 5, 2028. The cast will include Sadie Sink as Jean Grey, Kit Connor as Cyclops, Samara Weaving as Emma Frost, Inde Navarrette as Rogue, Maya Boyd as Storm and Christopher Abbott as Prof. X. Adam Driver will play the evil Mr. Sinister. Related Stories 'Incredibles 3' Drops First Look Concept Art Ahead of Summer 2028 Release Date It will be the first X-Men movie since Disney acquired Fox and its library of mutant characters. Several X-Men heroes have popped up in the MCU in recent years, and the billion-dollar blockbuster “Deadpool & Wolverine” and hit animated series “X-Men ’97” on Disney+ have slowly brought the mutants back in force. Now, the heroes will get their first proper movie since Fox’s “Dark Phoenix.” Popular on Variety There have been cameos from Fox’s X-Men stars in MCU movies, like Patrick Stewart reprising his role as Prof. Charles Xavier in “Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.” Kelsey Grammer also appeared in the ending of “The Marvels” as the super-smart, blue-haired scientist Beast. After “Deadpool & Wolverine” paved the way for Fox’s X-Men characters to return, “Avengers: Doomsday” is going all out. Stewart and Grammer will be back for the team-up movie, in addition to Ian McKellen as the magnetic mastermind Magneto, James Marsden as the laser beam-shooting Cyclops, Alan Cumming as the teleporting Nightcrawler and Rebecca Romijn as the shape-shifter Mystique. articles.title: Urša Menart Recalls Finding Inspiration on Influencers’ Fake Tragic Life Stories for Intimate Dramedy ‘Everything That’s Wrong With You’
articles.full_text: Aug 15, 2026 1:53am PT Urša Menart Recalls Finding Inspiration on Influencers’ Fake Tragic Life Stories for Intimate Dramedy ‘Everything That’s Wrong With You’ The film, which investigates a murky aspect of online culture in an increasingly lonely world, is having its world premiere as part of the narrative feature competition at the Sarajevo Film Festival By Rafa Sales Ross Plus Icon Rafa Sales Ross Guest Contributor Latest Urša Menart Recalls Finding Inspiration on Influencers’ Fake Tragic Life Stories for Intimate Dramedy ‘Everything That’s Wrong With You’ 30 minutes ago Golden Lion Winner Milcho Manchevski Talks ‘Giving a Voice’ to Pulse Nightclub Survivors With ‘Good People’: ‘Our Job Was to Stay Out of the Way’ 22 hours ago ‘The Best Mother in the World’ Standout Shirley Cruz to Star in Clara Ferrer and Tainá Bevilacqua’s Trans Coming-of-Age ‘The She-Devil’ (EXCLUSIVE) 3 days ago See All Courtesy of Sarajevo Film Festival Right before the COVID-19 pandemic shut down the world, Slovenian director Urša Menart came across a curious phenomenon on the internet: young people, mostly women, making up tragic life stories to gather the increasingly sparse attention span of their followers. Even more curiously, the director realized people would often drop everything to visit these micro-influencers. The muddled parasocial relationship between poster and follower would come to inspire “Everything That’s Wrong With You,” having its world premiere as part of the narrative feature competition section at this year’s Sarajevo Film Festival . Related Stories 'Incredibles 3' Drops First Look Concept Art Ahead of Summer 2028 Release Date The dramedy first finds young Maruša (Anuša Kodelja) back in her home country of Slovenia after a season living in Berlin. She just lost her mother to cancer, and the grief only amplifies her sense of displacement. While aimlessly scrolling one day, Maruša comes across Alja (Klara Kuk), a nurse living in a small coastal town in Germany. She sends a first message, which quickly spirals into a fast-developing friendship that is put to the test once they finally meet in person. Popular on Variety “What fascinated me wasn’t really the aspect of people inventing these stories, but the other side, those who befriended those folks, who followed them, who traveled across continents to visit them,” Menart tells Variety . “This was the first germ of the idea, but then the whole isolation of COVID and becoming a mother for the first time made me super lonely at times. It got me thinking about the human need to connect.” The two main characters were born out of the director’s observations and “interesting people” she met and read about. In the almost seven years it took to get the project off the ground, Menart worked on other films such as “My Last Year as a Loser,” but continued to think about the story and work on research. “In Slovenia, the production process is quite long,” she notes. “It takes a while even after getting financing to secure co-producers, financing from abroad and so on. I always worried: will this theme even interest me six years from now? Because making a film is a marathon.” Little could Menart know that the themes of her film would only become more relevant in the years since, especially as the rapid advancement of technologies such as artificial intelligence amplified conversations around loneliness and the need for human connection. “Humans are connecting more and more with machines, while on the other hand slowly realizing how important it is to spend actual time with each other.” Urša Menart, courtesy of Rado Likon As major discussions around the male loneliness epidemic and how young men are being seduced into the dark corners of the manosphere and red-pill movements due to an increase in isolation, Menart offers a careful observation on how loneliness affects young women. “Everything That’s Wrong With You” broaches questions on the burden of caring, the pressures of coupling up and bearing children and the hypersexualized universe of online dating. “I’m a woman, and that’s the perspective that feels like home,” says the director when asked about why she decided to focus on two young women. “And, to be honest, I think women live more interesting lives [laughs]. We have it harder, but our lives are very rich and unexamined still. We’ve had wonderful films and novels in the past decades dealing with the interior lives of women, but I still feel like there is still so much that is left unexplored and so many interesting characters that still haven’t been able to speak to the audience. So someone else can make a film about the male loneliness epidemic, I’m all for it, but it’s not going to be me [laughs].” Menart always knew her film would hinge on the casting of the two main actors. “I wanted actors from Slovenia because language is very important to me, and that meant our pool of actors was not huge,” she notes. “I still wanted to do open auditions, so I urged everyone and everyone’s friends to send in self-tapes to see what we would get.” Funnily enough, the two stars sent in tapes for the opposite characters. This, the director says, made her realize that “they each brought in an aspect of their personality that maybe would be missing in the script for the character.” After casting was completed, Menart spent a year working with the actors on developing their characters and adjusting the script accordingly. Another key aspect of the production was finding the perfect location for Alja’s home, which ended up being the small German seaside town of Heringsdorf. “I was really attracted to this flat landscape, which is something we don’t really have where I am from,” says the director. “I also wanted to have a big contrast from where Maruša comes from, which is all very steep and claustrophobic. I wanted to have this feeling that when she arrives at this other location, everything opens a bit.” “It was a bit of a challenge because it is a tourist town that doesn’t have the infrastructure to support the making of a feature,” she adds. “There was no space to park trucks, so we had to be very agile and work with smaller vans and not a lot of equipment, very minimal lights. But it actually suited me very well. It’s a small story and very intimate, so I wanted to be flexible and I couldn’t plan everything ahead.” Speaking of intimacy, Menart wanted to work with a cinematographer with a documentary background, who “would approach this shoot as more of ‘let’s catch the actors doing something’ instead of ‘let’s make the actors do something.’” When she met Dutch cinematographer Roy van Egmond through a producer friend, she “connected immediately.” “It was important for us to have this great conversation between the camera and the actors so that the camera would enter the intimacy of this very close relationship. We felt we needed to have this little cocoon of people who really understood one another.” As for having the world premiere of the film in Sarajevo, Menart says she is “really happy” to be back at the festival after presenting “Everything That’s Wrong With You” as part of CineLink, Sarajevo’s industry arm. “The festival is like a joyful high school reunion of the whole region, and they were so supportive of the film while we were making it. It feels perfect.” “Everything That’s Wrong With You” is produced by Slovenia’s Vertigo in co-production with Germany’s Chromosom Film, Tidewater Pictures, Serbia’s Living Pictures and RTV Slovenija. It is supported by the Slovenian Film Centre, MV Filmförderung, Film Center Serbia, the Ministry of Culture of the Republic of Serbia, Creative Europe MEDIA, the Ministry of Public Administration of the Republic of Slovenia, and Re-Act Co-Development Funding. In collaboration with Film Studio Viba Film. articles.title: ‘Blue Bloods’ Showrunner Rejects Bill O’Reilly Labeling ‘Boston Blue’ A “Woke Version”: “I Root For It”
articles.full_text: Skip to main content Dismiss News Banner Breaking News Marvel’s 'X-Men' Adds Christopher Abbott, Adam Driver, Inde Navarette & Maya Boyd; Release Date Set Read the full story By Glenn Garner Glenn Garner Associate Editor @xoxo_glenn More Stories By Glenn ‘Blue Bloods’ Showrunner Rejects Bill O’Reilly Labeling ‘Boston Blue’ A “Woke Version”: “I Root For It” ‘Never Have I Ever’s Maitreyi Ramakrishnan Jokes “Devi’s Dead” While Discussing Possible Return, If “All The Stars Lined Up” Ryan De Nino Dead: ‘Married at First Sight’ Alum Was 40 View All August 14, 2026 9:16pm Mika Amonsen as Sean Reagan, Donnie Wahlberg as Danny Reagan and Sonequa Martin-Green as Lena Silver in 'Boston Blue' Ian Watson/CBS Although the Reagans might not be in the same city anymore, Blue Bloods showrunner Kevin Wade supports the direction of the CBS spin-off. In a recent conversation with Bill O’Reilly, the Golden Globe nominee rejected the No Spin News host’s take that the offshoot is a “woke version” of the original, noting that he’s “happy for them.” O’Reilly argued, “ Boston Blue is woke. I mean, they got every ethnicity in the world coming in there. I don’t know who’s who, I can’t keep track of where these people are from and what they’re doing. Whereas Blue Bloods was Irish Catholic traditional down the line. Related Stories Cancellations and Renewals ‘Boston Blue’ & ‘Sheriff Country’ Renewed For Season 2 By CBS News ‘Boston Blue’ Promo Reveals Season 2 Release Date “So, do you think that the suits in Hollywood said, ‘Enough of this traditional stuff. It might be working, but we can make a woke version of this and make just as as much money’?” he asked. Watch on Deadline Wade praised Donnie Wahlberg for doing “a terrific job” in reprising his role as Danny Reagan, adding, “And I’m going to be on the side of my colleagues here and go, anytime something is providing jobs for actors and the huge amount of people that are employed as crew, I’m happy for them, and I root for it.” With Blue Bloods , Wade also didn’t see there being “a political agenda,” because although the show “was perceived as a maybe a right-leaning show—it was certainly about a family of white Roman Catholic Brooklyn cops, and cops and law enforcement in general tend to lean to the right. “If we had a little secret sauce, it was that when we built a soapbox for one side, we tried to make sure to build a soapbox of equal dimensions for the other side of an issue,” explained Wade. “We had to take on a lot of issues, and we chose to take on a lot of issues during the run of the show. I think that if there was a reason for its success … it was that people didn’t feel preached to. They didn’t feel like we were telling them what to think, or how to think, or what side was the right side.” Following Blue Bloods ‘ 2024 finale, Wahlberg reprised his role as Det. Danny Reagan in the spin-off Boston Blue , which premiered last October, with the role of Danny’s Sean recast with Mika Amonsen after Andrew Terraciano played him in the parent series.
